fusions.name: Calling the Herd
fusions.desc: A clap that calls the herd in, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Strays Swatted
fusions.desc: Reaches out to swat one straying enemy up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Touch
fusions.desc: Lays warm palms on your companions: every ally in your party regains 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bottle-Fed Calf
fusions.desc: A grazen calf you raised by hand follows you as a familiar, butting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.
